answer.notes:
The brief sets evidence=panel, so this is an off-chain fact read from a primary source rather than a chain reduction; no chain recipe in the catalogue can produce a marketplace floor, and none was used for the figure.

Window check first. eth_chainId returned 0x1 and eth_getBlockByNumber(0x18d0e62) returned hash 0x57ff11be472b4334700b39dfba20ef12b29a63d03ddb740dce049e8a6e8e4397 with timestamp 0x6ab052bb (2026-09-20T21:40:11Z) identically on three operators: https://rpc.flashbots.net/fast, https://rpc.mevblocker.io/fast and https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com. That matches the pinned toBlockHash. The opening block 26021177 is 0x58fbbc0569085560f91647faf49f94be0687c46384d66b014fc8ac54c9f2e84f at 2026-09-20T20:40:11Z; head was 26021627 when checked, so the window had closed. Contract identity was confirmed with eth_call at block 26021474 on https://rpc.mevblocker.io/fast: name() = "Opepen Edition", totalSupply() = 15766 (https://rpc.flashbots.net/fast does not whitelist eth_call and https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com refuses archive calls, so only one endpoint served the historical call).

The figure. OpenSea's public REST API answered without a key. https://api.opensea.io/api/v2/collections/opepen-edition/stats gives total.floor_price = 0.0927999 with floor_price_symbol ETH. https://api.opensea.io/api/v2/listings/collection/opepen-edition/best?limit=1 returns the cheapest active listing, whose Seaport consideration items sum exactly to 92799900000000000 wei (91871901000000000 + 927999000000000) and whose price.current.value is the same integer, so the wei value is exact and not a float rounded up from the published 0.0927999. The returned asset.contract is the pinned 0x6339e5e072086621540d0362c4e3cea0d643e114, which is how the slug opepen-edition was tied to the contract. The best-listing cursor opens at 0.0927999, confirming nothing is listed lower in that book.

Cross-checks. Alchemy's NFT API (https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/nft/v3/docs-demo/getFloorPrice) independently reported openSea 0.0927999 ETH retrieved 2026-09-20T22:10:23Z and looksRare 9.0 ETH retrieved 2025-02-13 (stale and far higher, so not the floor). CoinGecko (https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/nfts/ethereum/contract/0x6339e5e072086621540d0362c4e3cea0d643e114) reported floor_price.native_currency 0.0928 ETH, the same number at its four-decimal precision, alongside a 24h volume of 5.6 ETH over 67 sales and an average sale price of 0.0836 ETH, which is consistent with a floor just under 0.093 ETH.

What could not be done. Blur's core API is behind Cloudflare from this machine and returned an HTML challenge, so Blur's book was not read directly; api.reservoir.tools did not connect and the Magic Eden Reservoir proxy returned 400 for this contract. If a Blur-only ask sat below 0.0927999 ETH at 22:13Z it would not appear here. The floor listing is one of a rolling series of 15-minute relists of token #5063 by 0x88880de439babf4ce0aa60b81b3a91de9cb5f495: successive reads returned different order hashes with the same 92799900000000000 wei price, so the level is stable even though any single order is short-lived.

Assumption of record: the price is the buyer's total including the 1% OpenSea fee. A member who reports the seller's proceeds instead would answer 91871901000000000.

definitions.floor: the lowest price of a single active, publicly fillable listing of one token of the collection, i.e. the best ask across the marketplace order books that could be read from this machine; collection offers/bids are not listings and are excluded, and bundle listings (more than one token in one order) are excluded

definitions.collection: Opepen Edition, ERC-721 contract 0x6339e5e072086621540d0362c4e3cea0d643e114 on Ethereum mainnet; name() returns "Opepen Edition" and totalSupply() is 15766 at the closing block 26021474, confirmed by eth_call at that block on https://rpc.mevblocker.io/fast

No quantity in this answer is aggregated over the range
definitions.denomination: native ETH. Only listings denominated in native ETH are counted; listings priced in WETH or any other ERC-20 are not converted or compared, matching how OpenSea publishes this collection's floor (floor_price_symbol = ETH)
definitions.time_of_reading: 2026-09-20T22:13:13Z, which is 1982 seconds (about 33 minutes) after the closing block's timestamp 2026-09-20T21:40:11Z (0x6ab052bb). Marketplace listings are off-chain: there is no RPC state at block 26021474 that encodes them, so "as of the pinned window" is served by the earliest reading this run could take after the window closed. The same value was read at 22:10:23Z, 22:11Z, 22:12:26Z and 22:13:13Z, so it was stable across the whole interval between the close and the reading
definitions.price_of_a_listing: the total amount a buyer must pay to fill the order, which for Seaport is the sum of every consideration item (seller proceeds plus marketplace fee plus creator fee), not the seller's net proceeds. The floor listing at the time of reading was Seaport order 0x4b551005bf65368848df7f1827a50633825c04f22ef88ba63605bfa9529d4618 on token #5063: 91871901000000000 wei to the offerer plus 927999000000000 wei to the OpenSea fee recipient 0x0000a26b00c1f0df003000390027140000faa719, total 92799900000000000 wei
